articles.title: Enes Kanter Freedom ejected from WNBA game after confrontation with Natasha Cloud
articles.summary: Former NBA center criticized WNBA’s transgender policy. Cloud yelled and pointed in his direction after scoring. Former NBA center Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday night’s Indiana Fever v Chicago Sky WNBA game after he was confronted by Sky guard Natasha Cloud late in the third quarter.
body: Freedom was sitting along the baseline. He had on a black shirt that read “WOMAN. Noun. Adult human female.”

The Fever called for a time out after Cloud scored inside with 1:22 left in the third quarter. Cloud then did a chest bump with teammate Aicha Coulibaly before turning around and walking in Kanter’s direction.

Cloud, 34, started yelling and pointing at Kanter, 34, as she approached him. A standing Kanter held his arms out and took one step on the court as security and a handful of Sky players moved in between the two.
“There was just a fan incident and the security handled it, and we’re just going to focus on the game,” Chicago forward Azura Stevens said after the Sky’s 113-90 loss.

articles.title: Ceferin brands Infantino’s failed World Cup plan as ‘even worse than the Super League’
articles.summary: Fifa president will face opponent if he seeks re-election. Ceferin: ‘We stopped another try to steal the sport’ The Uefa president, Aleksander Ceferin, has described Gianni Infantino’s doomed attempt to sell stakes in the World Cup as “even worse than the Super League plan” and warned his embattled…
body: Ceferin has led Uefa’s firm collective stance against the Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) scheme, which was shelved amid widespread opposition at the start of August. Uefa are pushing for Infantino to quit, also drawing on support from Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation, and are yet to drop a threat to boycott Fifa competitions while talks are under way with Concacaf to set up a combined Nations League tournament.

In an interview with the podcast The Rest is Politics: Leading, Ceferin denounced Infantino’s project as more damaging than the breakaway Super League that was shelved in 2021 after large-scale protests. “I think this plan is even worse than the Super League plan,” he said. “In the first case, super-important clubs wanted to do their own league, which is wrong and would destroy football. But in this case, football would be literally sold.

“I’m absolutely sure that the [FFE] plan is dead. For me, the most important thing is that we stopped another try to sell the sport. It’s hard to imagine what kind of people would sell the sport that belongs to everyone.”

articles.title: Wrexham hunt quality to end tough transfer window
articles.summary: Wrexham chief executive Mike Williamson says their relatively quiet transfer window is a result of competing against bigger clubs for top-level talent.
body: The Red Dragons have added three recruits for the Championship promotion push, which has started with 1-1 draws against Cardiff City and Watford.
Last summer Wrexham signed 13 players – and brought in three more in January – to help them go close to making the play-offs on their return to the second tier.
"Going into the transfer market this summer we said we would look to add some quality, not quantity," Williamson told Radio Wales Sport before Saturday's draw against the Hornets.
"We have the foundations of a really strong Championship squad, so knew what we needed to be competitive and make a bit of a difference."

articles.title: Arthur Fils wins first Masters title after beating Frances Tiafoe in Cincinnati final
articles.summary: 22-year-old wins 6-3, 1-6, 6-0. Fils now ranked No 11 in world. Arthur Fils has always believed he was on the path to the very top of his chosen sport. Even when others considered him too young, too green or far too self-confident, he has entered the biggest tournaments in the world with the…
body: On a historic afternoon in Mason, Ohio, Fils took an huge step forward in pursuit of those massive goals as the 22-year-old became a Masters 1000 champion for the first time in his young career. His greatest achievement was secured with a supreme mental effort under pressure as the Frenchman dragged himself back into contention after a desperate second set, recovering to defeat Frances Tiafoe 6-3, 1-6, 6-0 and win the Cincinnati Open.

Even before a ball was struck, this was a historic moment: the first ATP Masters 1000 final played between two black players. The pair have built such a great rapport that before this match, the biggest final of their careers, they cracked jokes together as they departed the practice courts side-by-side. After taking a customary picture with the guest invited on-court to deliver the coin toss, Fils insisted on taking a picture with Tiafoe alone to mark the occasion.

articles.summary: Chicago Sky head coach Tyler Marsh had a message of support for his guard, Natasha Cloud, after the Enes Kanter incident in their 110-93 loss to the Indiana Fever. Cloud played an integral role in the circumstances that led to Kanter being removed from courtside after the former NBA player attended…
body: Cloud addressed words to Kanter after scoring a bucket, with Kanter’s response leading to his removal from the game. With some blaming Cloud for the incident, her head coach has set the record straight.
Sky head coach Tyler Marsh passionately defended Cloud after the game, highlighting that her standing up for the team and being their enforcer will always be appreciated by the squad.
“I told her that we all embrace her as someone who protects our team and protects people who need to be protected. Tash is always going to stand on that, and we stand for Tash.”

Kanter’s courtside presence was a massive distraction to the players, especially with Kanter’s recent crusade to get the WNBA to ban trans athletes by threatening to identify as a woman and declaring for the WNBA Draft.

articles.title: Infantino must remember he is European - Ceferin
articles.summary: Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin says his Fifa counterpart Gianni Infantino's attempt to sell off a stake in the World Cup was "worse than the Super League".
body: Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin says Gianni Infantino needs to remember he is European after describing his Fifa counterpart's plan to sell off a stake in the World Cup as "worse than the Super League".

Earlier this month the world governing body abandoned Infantino's proposal to create a new company - Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) - to manage the commercial and ticketing rights of all Fifa competitions, with 21% to be sold off to a private investment company.
Uefa led opposition to the plan, with its members voting to boycott World Cups unless it was scrapped.
European football's governing body has since said it has lost confidence in Infantino, while the football associations of all the home nations have withdrawn support for the 56-year-old Swiss.

articles.title: Everything to know about European T20 Premier League: Players, teams, owners and format of new ETPL cricket league
articles.summary: With the inaugural season of the European Premier League set to kick off, here's everything you need to know about the players, teams, owners, and format of the ETPL tournament.
body: Everything to know about European T20 Premier League: Players, teams, owners and format of new ETPL cricket league originally appeared on Cricket News. Add Cricket News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.

European cricket has spent the better part of a decade chasing a franchise league of its own, and the wait finally ends this month. The European T20 Premier League launches its inaugural season on August 26, backed by three national boards and sanctioned by the ICC.

The competition is jointly organised by Cricket Ireland, Cricket Scotland and the Royal Dutch Cricket Association and represents the second attempt at this concept. Before this, there was the Euro T20 Slam that was scheduled for 2019, with Eoin Morgan, Dale Steyn and Shahid Afridi already signed, only to collapse a fortnight before the opening match when its promoters ran into financial difficulty.

This version has been rebuilt from the ground up. Co-founded by Bollywood actor Abhishek Bachchan alongside Saurav Banerjee, Priyanka Kaul and former Delhi Capitals chief executive Dhiraj Malhotra, the ETPL was itself pushed back a year from its original 2025 launch because of investment delays.

articles.title: Late Clark magic holds off McIlroy and Cantlay in PGA Tour thriller
articles.summary: Wyndham Clark overcame blowing a five-shot lead to edge out Rory McIlroy with a dramatic three-shot victory at the PGA Tour's BMW Championship.
body: Clark saw his big overnight lead disappear during a thrilling Sunday at Bellerive Country Club, where the US Open champion bogeyed three of his first 10 holes to give hope to McIlroy and the chasing pack.

McIlroy found three birdies in a four-hole stretch around the turn to sit level with Clark heading into the closing stretch, only for his playing partner to post a three-birdie finish to cap off a roller-coaster victory in style.

A level-par 70 was enough for Clark to end the week on 17 under and close out a third PGA Tour victory of the season, following on from the CJ Cup Byron Nelson and the US Open, with Patrick Cantlay claiming solo second to progress through to next week's season-ending Tour Championship.

McIlroy was tied for the lead with three to play but ended four back after a penultimate-hole bogey and Clark's impressive birdie burst, while Gary Woodland, Collin Morikawa and Chris Gotterup shared fourth place.

articles.title: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty Reportedly Suffers Ankle Sprain In Practice
articles.summary: The Las Vegas Raiders were dealt a major scare during practice on Sunday. Luckily for them, though, it appears that's all it was. Running back Ashton Jeanty is believed to have an ankle sprain after departing practice early on Sunday, ESPN reported.
body: Jeanty's departure from practice led to a lot of concern out of Raiders camp. He suffered the apparent injury after diving for a catch and colliding with cornerback Darien Porter. After he was down on the ground for a moment, Jeanty needed to be helped off the field and couldn't put any weight on his right leg. The team also took a knee in prayer.

First-year head coach Klint Kubiak is expected to make Jeanty the centerpiece of the offense this season alongside tight end Brock Bowers. They also added depth by drafting Arkansas running back Mike Washington Jr. in the fourth round to add more versatility.

Jeanty and Washington Jr. were expected to form a potential 1-2 punch for the offense, although Jeanty likely would've received the majority of the touches out of the backfield. Kubiak previously deployed one of the league’s top running back duos with the Seattle Seahawks last season that featured Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker and Zach Charbonnet.

Jeanty struggled for good portions of his rookie season after the Raiders took him with the sixth overall pick. He rushed for 975 yards and only five touchdowns while averaging just 3.7 yards per carry, which ranked 45th in the league.
